test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a correct pair of a country and its capital?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kazakhstan – Bishkek**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kazakhstan’s capital is Nur-Sultan**, formerly known as Astana until 2019.
 
• Bishkek is the capital of **Kyrgyzstan**, not Kazakhstan.
 
• The mistake in the pair is that it incorrectly associates Bishkek with Kazakhstan instead of Kyrgyzstan.
 
• Nur-Sultan, the current capital of Kazakhstan, was renamed from Astana in honor of the former president Nursultan Nazarbayev.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bahamas**:

 
 
• The capital of Bahamas is **Nassau**.
 
• Nassau is located on the island of New Providence, which is the most populous island in the Bahamas.
 
 
 
• **Libya**:
 
 
• The capital of Libya is **Tripoli**.
 
• Tripoli is the largest city in Libya and the principal seaport of the country.
 
 
 
• **Belgium**:
 
 
• The capital of Belgium is **Brussels**.
 
• Brussels is also the de facto capital of the European Union (EU) and hosts several major EU institutions.
 
 
 
• **Kazakhstan**:
 
 
• The correct capital of Kazakhstan is **Nur-Sultan**.
 
• Nur-Sultan was known as Astana until it was renamed in 2019 to honor the first president of Kazakhstan, Nursultan Nazarbayev.
 
 
 
• **Kyrgyzstan**:
 
 
• The capital of Kyrgyzstan is **Bishkek**.
 
• Bishkek is the largest city in Kyrgyzstan and serves as the country’s political, economic, and cultural center.
